sections.heading: 1. Three simple changes
lines: ① Basket on a chair or trolley at waist height.
② Stand close to the line, face it, no twisting.
③ Every few items, stand tall and stretch.
④ Big load? Hang it in two trips.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…
lines: Pain spreads down a leg, or your back

caption:
Koko hangs out the washing four times a week, and her lower back feels stiff afterwards.

Bending to a basket on the ground and reaching up to the line, over and over, can add up for your back. Raising the basket to waist height, standing close to the line and pausing to stand tall every few items can make the job easier.

Pain that spreads down a leg, numbness, or stiffness that lingers for more than two weeks is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🧺
